query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM crm_contacts ct
                        JOIN crm_companies co ON co.id = ct.company_id
                        JOIN team_crm_settings tcs ON tcs.team_id = co.team_id AND tcs.crm_enabled
                        WHERE ct.id = $1
                          AND co.team_id = $2
                          AND (NOT (ct.hidden OR co.hidden) OR $3)
                    ) AS "visible!"
